lessons.title: Siege Tank Support
lessons.when: Early midgame (~5 min) with both players ground-oriented, heavy economy and tech, opponent shows Marine cues, you have Siege Tanks and Marines.
lessons.why: Siege Tanks provide strong defensive and positional advantages in TvT. Maintaining a heavy economy and tech allows transition to advanced units if needed.
